title: Capstone: make a small open-cancer-data analysis fully reproducible
context: The capstone is an authentic-assessment task where learners integrate all curriculum skills: they take a small open-cancer-data analysis and produce a fully reproducible artifact (pinned container + literate analysis + provenance + data/code-availability statement), graded against the checklist-012 rubric. A reference solution is provided to make the capstone self-deliverable and CI-verifiable. The source dataset must pass the data gate (datagate-002) before the capstone is authored. Depends on: datagate-002, analysis-010, checklist-012, container-ci-005.
objective: Build and document the capstone assignment and a reference solution: learners make a small open-cancer-data analysis fully reproducible (pinned container + literate analysis + provenance + data/code-availability statement), graded against checklist-012; reference solution builds and re-runs green in CI; signed off by Data & licensing, Domain, and Technical reviewers.
acceptanceCriteria: Capstone assignment instructions are clear, accessible, and suitable for a non-computational bench scientist; describe the expected deliverable: pinned container + literate analysis + provenance record + data/code-availability statement.
Grading rubric references checklist-012 with explicit criteria and point allocation; scoring key for instructors included.

Reference solution implements a small methodological open-cancer-data analysis: pinned container (Docker + Apptainer), literate document (Quarto or R Markdown or Jupyter), RO-Crate or equivalent provenance, and a filled-in data/code-availability statement.
Source dataset for the reference solution has a committed PASS gate artifact (datagate-002 criteria); no raw data committed; data fetched at runtime in bounded slices.
Reference solution builds and re-runs from scratch in CI (Docker + Apptainer); example renders green; CI catalog validator passes.
Reference solution presents no biological/clinical conclusion as a finding; labeled 'teaching example — not a finding, not advice.'
Reviewed and signed off by Data & licensing reviewer, Domain reviewer, and Technical reviewer; code MIT licensed; DCO signed off.
resources: DepMap (CC-BY 4.0) or GDC open-tier as reference solution dataset
output: Capstone assignment instructions, grading rubric, and a reference solution (pinned container + literate analysis + provenance + availability statement) committed as a PR; CI green; Data & licensing + Domain + Technical reviewer sign-offs.
